items.name: file-tree
items.title: File Tree
items.description: A bundle read as a tree: folders fold open under the pointer or the arrow keys, one highlight glides between rows, and a quiet right-hand column says how much each file holds.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Collapsible accordion sidebar with icon'd sections, an active rail, and socials.

items.name: macos-dock
items.title: macOS Dock
items.description: macOS-style magnifying dock — cursor-driven icon springs, click bounce, floor reflections, running-app dots, and a ⌘K command menu.

items.name: browser-window
items.title: Browser Window
items.description: Chrome / Safari mock window frame for screenshots and embeds; below 480px of its own width it becomes a phone browser with a status row, one address pill and a bottom toolbar.

items.name: macbook-frame
items.title: MacBook Frame
items.description: Front-facing MacBook mockup — drop a screenshot, gradient, or live UI on the screen.

items.name: card-stack
items.title: Card Stack
items.description: Draggable stacked-card carousel — swipe or drag the top card, click to expand into a details modal with a floating dock.

items.name: card-grid
items.title: Card Grid
items.description: Responsive grid of project cards with hover-reveal actions and a shared details modal.

items.name: card-list
items.title: Card List
items.description: Vertical list of horizontal project cards with media, copy, and a shared details modal.

items.name: bento-gallery
items.title: Bento Gallery
items.description: Draggable bento grid of media that expands into a shared lightbox modal with a floating dock switcher.

items.name: cutout-card
items.title: Cutout Card
items.description: Media card with a scooped-out content tray (concave corners), hover-reveal action button, and gradient overlay.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expanding accordion rows — each reveals its body, a checklist, and a visual.

items.name: project-card
items.title: Project Card
items.description: Shared cutout project card with blurred-gradient media and a liquid-metal hover ring.

items.name: historical-eps
items.title: Historical EPS
items.description: Forecast-vs-reported quarterly bars — dashed forecasts, a derived Beat-by tip, and a surprise tooltip.

items.name: price-target-fan
items.title: Price Target Fan
items.description: Analyst targets: history draws to now, dashed projections fan to High / Mean / Low, the nearest projection owns the pointer and the hot one draws solid, with a scrub card and a live ring on the now dot.

items.name: market-watchlist
items.title: Market Watchlist
items.description: A watchlist that reads as one chart: every watched coin as a line from the same open, a row per coin, and the whole market beside it in tokens, sectors and yields, where any row adds itself to the list.

items.name: sma-chart
items.title: SMA Chart
items.description: Moving-average chart — price line with fast/slow SMA overlays, crosshair scrubbing with a three-series tooltip, and a signed change chip.

items.name: dotted-area-chart
items.title: Dotted Area Chart
items.description: A price line standing on a field of dots that fades toward the floor. Scrubbing splits the chart at the cursor, lighting the stretch already passed and dropping the rest back, with a read-out carrying the bar's price and its move from the open.

items.name: health-gauge
items.title: Health Gauge
items.description: A bounded single-metric dial: a 270° arc on one flat track, a value arc that draws in behind an end marker, and a centre number that counts up to it. Clicking the dial cycles the metric and the arc redraws.

items.name: market-heatmap
items.title: Market Heatmap
items.description: The market as one block of ground: tiles sized by market cap on a hand-rolled squarified treemap, tinted on a diverging scale by the day's move. Hovering a tile parks a read-out beside it with price, change and cap; clicking pins it.

items.name: sankey-flow
items.title: Sankey Flow
items.description: A fund-flow diagram where income pools in one hub and fans out into uses, node and ribbon thickness standing for amount. Flow is conserved through the middle, so every outbound strand carries its source's hue across.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut Chart
items.description: Allocation as a ring rather than a pie: the stroke is a band around an open centre that the total sits in. Slices sort descending, ring and legend cross-highlight, and square caps keep the gaps between slices real.

items.name: balance-header
items.title: Balance Header
items.description: A wallet's headline number with its cents stepped back so the eye lands on the dollars, the move carried in a tinted pill beneath, and a privacy toggle that masks every figure to dots.

items.name: market-snapshot
items.title: Market Snapshot
items.description: Price snapshot card — animated headline price, period-sliced line chart with crosshair scrubbing, and a gliding period switcher.

items.name: index-card
items.title: Index Card
items.description: Markets sidebar card — one big price over a full-bleed scrubbable line, a tab underline that walks between indices, and the one-paragraph read below.

items.name: range-navigator
items.title: Range Navigator
items.description: Focus + context price history — a detail chart over a mini-map you drag to pan and pull to zoom, with a hover crosshair reading price and date.

items.name: sectors-donut
items.title: Sectors Donut
items.description: Allocation ring with legend cross-highlight — hovering isolates one weight at a time.

items.name: ratings-radar
items.title: Ratings Radar
items.description: Analyst-ratings pentagon with hairline rings and one green wedge toward the dominant rating.

items.name: analyst-radar
items.title: Analyst Radar
items.description: Two-series factor radar — subject filled against a dashed peer outline, a hovered spoke reading both values, and a legend that mutes a series.

items.name: kpi-card-row
items.title: KPI Card Row
items.description: Dashboard stat band — count-up headlines with signed deltas over full-bleed area charts you can hover to read any sample with its date.

items.name: heat-calendar
items.title: Heat Calendar
items.description: Weeks of activity as a sequential single-hue grid with month labels, a gliding date-and-count tooltip, a ripple on hover, click-to-span totals and a legend that filters by level.

items.name: returns-calendar
items.title: Returns Calendar
items.description: Monthly-returns heat grid: years by months diverging up/down by magnitude, a compounded year column, a gliding tooltip that dims everything unrelated, a year replay on hover, and click-to-span compounding by months or whole years.

items.name: holdings-table
items.title: Holdings Table
items.description: Fund-holdings register with YTD pills and tick-comb weight bars.

items.name: trade-journal-table
items.title: Trade Journal Table
items.description: A trade log where the open position is lit from its spine and every closed one settles into a win or loss pill; heads sort, the range thumb slides, net P&L carries its fee formula.

items.name: fills-blotter
items.title: Fills Blotter
items.description: A streaming order-fills table: new fills slide in at the top as working, then resolve in place to filled or rejected; hover a row for venue, order id and fee; pausable.

items.name: candlestick
items.title: Candlestick
items.description: Candles over a volume histogram with a magnet crosshair, a price badge on the right axis, a live OHLC legend and a switch to a plain close line.

items.name: equity-drawdown
items.title: Equity & Drawdown
items.description: A cumulative equity curve over a synced underwater drawdown panel; one crosshair reads equity, drawdown and days below the high-water mark.

items.name: balance-chart
items.title: Balance Chart
items.description: Wallet-value area chart: trend picks the colour, the high and low float at their true points, scrubbing greys everything ahead of the cursor, and timeframe pills reseed the walk.

items.name: price-scrubber
items.title: Price Scrubber
items.description: Scrub chart with a magnet crosshair, price and time badges on the axes, a hero number that recolours off the reference price, a wash under the pointer and timeframe pills.

items.name: comb-rows
items.title: Comb Rows
items.description: A comparison as rulers of ticks: the cursor tick stands taller at the value and the subject row carries the accent; hover hands it to another row.

items.name: ticker-tape
items.title: Ticker Tape
items.description: A finance tape gliding through a hairline rail on a seamless loop; hovering holds it still, moves read green up and red down.

items.name: trade-tape
items.title: Trade Tape
items.description: Live time and sales: prints stream in side-coloured and sized by a magnitude bar, block trades tint the row, and hovering pauses the tape.

items.name: simple-chart
items.title: Simple Chart
items.description: The compact asset-price card: one line, one number that scrubs under the pointer, and a signed-percent tag the line is de-trended to agree with.

items.name: matrix-ticker-board
items.title: Matrix Ticker Board
items.description: A retro dot-matrix price wall on canvas: 5×7 dot glyphs, and on each quote update only the changed characters dissolve out dot by dot and bloom back.

items.name: request-log
items.title: Request Log
items.description: API log rows with status pills that unfold their response body inline.

items.name: new-items-pill
items.title: New Items Pill
items.description: A live tape that pins the row you are reading — arrivals stop pushing the list down and count into a pill until you tap back to the top.

items.name: inbox
items.title: Inbox
items.description: Notification inbox — unread dots dissolve on read, mark-all clears the column.

items.name: project-index
items.title: Project Index
items.description: Bare project rows where the cover only exists while you hover, floating beside the cursor.

items.name: news-card
items.title: News Card
items.description: Auto-cycling news module with an ink headline and dot pagination.

items.name: alert-stack
items.title: Alert Stack
items.description: Collapsed notification deck that fans open on hover; each dismiss re-settles the pile.

items.name: assets-balance-card
items.title: Assets Balance Card
items.description: Deep-ground balance hero: rolling odometer digits, an ambient signal line, scrub readout, and a drag handle that pulls the chart taller.

items.name: onboarding-checklist
items.title: Onboarding Checklist
items.description: Setup checklist — the check draws in and the progress bar keeps a derivable score.

items.name: preferences-card
items.title: Preferences Card
items.description: Settings rows with icon tiles, one-line hints, and a chevron that walks in on hover.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: A dotted field, a hairline icon chip, one line of ink and one quiet action.

items.name: swap-ticket
items.title: Swap Ticket
items.description: Composed trade card. A flip button on the seam really swaps the cards, a token-select overlay covers the ticket, and the CTA label is the validation state.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Hairline pill whose thumb glides between options with a shared-layout spring.

items.name: avatar-stack
items.title: Avatar Stack
items.description: Overlapping gradient-orb coins with a surface ring. Hovering lifts and names a coin, and the overflow count floats the hidden names without widening the stack.

items.name: amount
items.title: Amount
items.description: Money-formatting family — Fiat, Crypto and Percent agree on symbol placement, precision, abbreviation and sign colouring.

items.name: crypto-fiat
items.title: Crypto/Fiat
items.description: Dual-denomination amount field. Type in fiat or units, the toggle carries the value through the rate, and the headline steps down a size tier as it grows.

items.name: screen-shuffle
items.title: Screen Shuffle
items.description: Stacked screens where the front card arcs to the back on a timer or click.

items.name: mouse-trail-cta
items.title: Mouse-Trail CTA
items.description: CTA stage where the cursor's particle trail gravitates into the pill and feeds its glow.

items.name: ascii-turntable
items.title: ASCII Turntable
items.description: An extruded solid that turns with the cursor and is redrawn as characters on a grid. The lighting is graded for the ramp, so the face lands mid-scale instead of saturating to one glyph.

items.name: metal-badge
items.title: Metal Badge
items.description: Any SVG mark as a domed chrome badge, drawn in WebGPU. It leans toward the cursor with the light following, and a click flips it. Falls back to a flat chrome face where WebGPU is missing.

items.name: stone-badge
items.title: Stone Badge
items.description: Any SVG mark as a carved stone badge, drawn in WebGPU: facets, fissures and mineral speckle on a roughened dome. It leans toward the cursor with the key light following, and a click flips it. Falls back to a flat stone face where WebGPU is missing.

items.name: gold-badge
items.title: Gold Badge
items.description: The metal badge in gold: any SVG mark as a domed, brushed gold badge drawn in WebGPU. It leans toward the cursor with the light following, and a click flips it.

items.name: holo-badge
items.title: Holographic Badge
items.description: Any SVG mark as a holographic badge: a silver dome under a thin film whose colour shifts with the angle, with a fine sparkle. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click.

items.name: glass-badge
items.title: Glass Badge
items.description: Any SVG mark as a frosted glass badge: translucent, with the light catching its rolled edge and the page showing through. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click.

items.name: neon-badge
items.title: Neon Badge
items.description: Any SVG mark as a dark badge with a neon outline that glows and breathes. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click.

items.name: lightning-badge
items.title: Lightning Badge
items.description: Any SVG mark as a dark glass badge with lightning crawling over its face. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click.

items.name: ascii-badge
items.title: ASCII Badge
items.description: Any SVG mark as a domed badge drawn in characters: the lit surface is read per cell and each cell's brightness picks a character from the ramp, so the letters change with the light as it turns. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click.

items.name: account-dropdown
items.title: Account Dropdown
items.description: Wallet accounts with balances under the one in use; pointing reads its share, pressing switches

items.name: depth-chart
items.title: Depth Chart
items.description: Bid and ask staircases around the mid; scrubbing reads the size resting at the same distance on both sides

items.name: gantt-mini
items.title: Gantt Mini
items.description: A two week sprint strip with a today line; pointing at a task reads its dates, length and owner

items.name: leverage-ticket
items.title: Leverage Ticket
items.description: Margin, side and a leverage slider; size, fee and the liquidation price follow as the slider moves

items.name: order-book
items.title: Order Book
items.description: A two sided ladder with depth bars; pointing at a level lights the run up to it and reads its size and money

items.name: quick-ticket
items.title: Quick Ticket
items.description: A watchlist line that opens into an order ticket; the white button names the order it will place

items.name: setup-stepper
items.title: Setup Stepper
items.description: Numbered setup steps down a rail; press any step to open it, Continue moves one on and checks the last

items.name: tool-call-card
items.title: Tool Call Card
items.description: One agent tool call with its arguments and result; the head folds it, Run again replays the call

items.name: vitals-strip
items.title: Vitals Strip
items.description: A row of figures with a live trade count; pointing at a cell reads how its figure is worked out

items.name: agent-run-timeline
items.title: Agent Run Timeline
items.description: The steps of one agent run with tool, time and state; press a step to open its input and output

items.name: automation-builder
items.title: Automation Builder
items.description: A trading rule written as sentences; press a value to swap it in place, drag rows, run a simulated sweep

items.name: dialog-stack
items.title: Dialog Stack
items.description: Dialogs that pile up one step at a time; the top card moves on, Back or Escape takes it off

items.name: graph-comparison
items.title: Graph Comparison
items.description: Up to four series indexed to the window start; press one to take it off, scrub to read every close

items.name: market-shelf
items.title: Market Shelf
items.description: A shelf of market tiles with price, day change and week line; pointing at a tile reads its week

items.name: order-ticket
items.title: Order Ticket
items.description: A limit or market order where price, amount and total keep each other true and the button names the state

items.name: radial-gauge
items.title: Radial Gauge
items.description: A pass rate on a 270 degree dial over its bands; pointing at a band reads its range in percent and checks

items.name: stacked-bars
items.title: Stacked Bars
items.description: Monthly totals stacked by series; pointing at a segment or a name reads its value and its share

items.name: top-coins
items.title: Top Coins
items.description: A rail of coin prices with their move over the window; scrub a line to read any week in place of the price

items.name: volume-profile
items.title: Volume Profile
items.description: Volume by price with the point of control and value area named; scrub to read any level's share

items.name: allocation-treemap
items.title: Allocation Treemap
items.description: Holdings as tiles sized by their share of the book; point at a tile to read its weight and value

items.name: event-feed
items.title: Event Feed
items.description: Market events grouped by day with price and move; point at one to read its move in dollars

items.name: info-card
items.title: Info Card
items.description: A quiet card with a title and one line; pointing at it opens its action row

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: The library's dialog with title, body and actions; Tab stays inside and Escape closes it

items.name: payment-card
items.title: Payment Card
items.description: The card on file in a pocket; pointing at the sheet lifts the card out to read its face

items.name: release-feed
items.title: Release Feed
items.description: A changelog on a rail; point at a kind to filter notes, press a version to copy it

items.name: stat-tile
items.title: Stat Tile
items.description: Compact metrics with value, signed change and a tiny line; move across one to read any point

items.name: total-balance
items.title: Total Balance
items.description: The account as one line over a window; scrub to read any point, pills switch the window

items.name: wallet-drawer
items.title: Wallet Drawer
items.description: A wallet in one column with holdings, lists behind pills, and send, receive and settings views

items.name: amount-slider
items.title: Amount Slider
items.description: Pick a share of a balance on a rail or four quarter pills, read back as share, amount and dollar value

items.name: cross-chain-swap
items.title: Cross Chain Swap
items.description: Swap an asset on one network for one on another, the round button turns the whole route around

items.name: execution-controls
items.title: Execution Controls
items.description: Hold the button to send an order, it reads working, then filled or rejected, with a timed undo

items.name: inline-slider
items.title: Inline Slider
items.description: A filter slider with its name and value inside the track, the thumb parts where it crosses the words

items.name: model-comparison
items.title: Model Comparison
items.description: Models side by side on quality, latency, cost and context, pointing at a value reads its gap to the best

items.name: performance-chart
items.title: Performance Chart
items.description: Your return against a benchmark, green while ahead and red behind, scrub to read the gap on any day

items.name: scatter-plot
items.title: Scatter Plot
items.description: Stocks on risk and return, pointing at a point names it and drops a hairline to each axis

items.name: swap-confirm
items.title: Swap Confirm
items.description: Sell one holding for another and see the rate and the least you will receive before you press

items.name: uptime-bars
items.title: Uptime Bars
items.description: Ninety days of uptime as a bar a day, scrub to read any day's uptime and its incident

items.name: watchlist-stack
items.title: Watchlist Stack
items.description: Watched shares with a session line, price and move, scrub a line to read the price at that moment

items.name: approval-quorum
items.title: Approval Quorum
items.description: N of M sign off. Press a role to sign or take it back, the meter turns green when the quorum is met

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: Two month sheet with presets. First press drops an end, days fill in behind the pointer, second press sets it

items.name: flow-bars
items.title: Flow Bars
items.description: Daily net flows as signed bars off a zero line. Hover reads a day, drag sums a run, arrows page through time

items.name: kanban-board
items.title: Kanban Board
items.description: Three column board with counts. Point at a card to read it, press it to move it to the next column

items.name: morph-disclosure
items.title: Morph Disclosure
items.description: A project row that grows in place into a short sheet of summary and facts. Press or Escape folds it back

items.name: positions-table
items.title: Positions Table
items.description: Open positions with entry, mark, liquidation and P&L. Point at a row to read its margin, press to hold and close

items.name: series-spotlight
items.title: Series Spotlight
items.description: Twelve lines with one lit. Hover the rail to preview a line, press to light it, scrub to read that one

items.name: tape-flow
items.title: Tape Flow
items.description: Last 48 prints as bars, tall for size, green or red by side. Scrub to read a print, press to hold it

items.name: view-switch
items.title: View Switch
items.description: Desktop, mobile and code switcher. Only the chosen option shows its name, one thumb slides between them

items.name: portfolio-book
items.title: Portfolio Overview (paid screen)
items.description: The balance-first book on one ruled grid: holdings, history and share-of-total composed from six library components, with the page composing and never editing them.

items.name: portfolio-allocation
items.title: Portfolio Allocation (paid screen)
items.description: Composition first. Leads with what the book is made of and how concentrated it is, which is the analyst's first question rather than the owner's.

items.name: portfolio-tiers
items.title: Multi-account Portfolio (paid screen)
items.description: The book as four accounts rather than one balance. One pill per tier under the bar, and the pill row is a selector rather than decoration, carrying share-of-total on the tier.

items.name: discover-board
items.title: Market Discovery (paid screen)
items.description: The browsing problem, not the reporting one: filters and a trending rail for finding something you do not already hold.

items.name: discover-screener
items.title: Token Screener (paid screen)
items.description: The screener take on discovery: a dense sortable board where the row is the unit and the filters carry the state.

items.name: terminal-cex
items.title: Trading Terminal (paid screen)
items.description: An exchange terminal on one ruled workspace: candle chart under an interval bar, book or tape as tabs, ticket and account on the right, and a full-width positions register at the fold.

items.name: gpu-pods
items.title: GPU Marketplace (paid screen)
items.description: A GPU rental marketplace's browse screen: 150 pods in a 15-column table you can sort, search and cross-read, with a filter rail whose counts are honest and a product rail of its own. White on black, no accent hue.

items.name: wallet-home
items.title: Crypto Wallet (paid screen)
items.description: A self-custody wallet's home and coin pages in one screen: balance, four actions, every coin by share, and a coin's own chart, position and activity one click away, with a working swap beside them.

items.name: business-balances
items.title: Business Balances (paid screen)
items.description: A business account's cash across five currencies: one total in any display currency, scheduled money in and out, idle cash moved into yield, and transfers, conversions and payment links that update the balances they touch.

items.name: payout-balance
items.title: Payout Balance (paid screen)
items.description: A seller's balance and its ledger: available, reserved and treasury money as one split, and every payment, refund and payout in a filterable, reorderable table, with deposit, withdraw and move flows that write new rows.

items.name: money-account
items.title: Multi-currency Account (paid screen)
items.description: A personal account across four currencies: the total, the month's money in and out, a balance per currency with its own account details, and send, add money and request flows that stack as sheets.

items.name: wealth-invest
items.title: Wealth Portfolio (paid screen)
items.description: A household's investments against the market: portfolio growth drawn against four benchmarks, every holding in one sortable table, and an assistant whose answers cite the numbers and the sources they come from.

items.name: market-watchlist
items.title: Market Watchlist (paid screen)
items.description: A watchlist that reads as one chart: every watched coin as a line from the same open, a row per coin, and the whole market beside it in tokens, sectors and yields, where any row adds itself to the list.

items.name: asset-alerts
items.title: Asset and Alerts (paid screen)
items.description: One asset's page with its price alerts: the day's line green above the open and red below it, the position, a swap card, and an alerts panel to search, sort, switch on and off and create from.

items.name: ascii-scroll-morph
items.title: ASCII Scroll Morph (paid screen)
items.description: An immersive landing page with live 3D ASCII shapes that respond to the cursor and transition as you scroll. Adapt the vector artwork, copy and colours in code to fit your brand, while keeping the motion system intact.

items.name: tradeboard-landing
items.title: Trading Platform Landing (paid screen)
items.description: A product landing built on one rule: one ground, one subject, one accent. Giant display headline, the product UI as the hero image, then metric cards, a bento container grid and a three-step band.

items.name: stablecoin-landing
items.title: Stablecoin Landing (paid screen)
items.description: A token landing on the same structure: hero with a brand marquee, a three-card product explainer, a backers marquee and a use-modes grid. Everything structural is shared with the Tradeboard page, so the two stay one system.

items.name: simple-landing
items.title: Developer Tools Landing (paid screen)
items.description: The library's own marketing page: a near-black ground, one object per section, two-tone display type carrying the hierarchy, and every count read live from the registry.
